The diagram shows a sealed jar containing a gas.
gas
Which statement about the gas in the jar is correct?
A
The gas molecules collide with the inside of the jar more often as the temperature increases.
B
The gas molecules move more slowly as the temperature increases.
C
The pressure of the gas decreases as the temperature increases.
D
The pressure of the gas is higher at the top of the jar than at the bottom of the jar.

options.label: A
options.text: The gas molecules collide with the inside of the jar more often as the temperature increases.

options.label: B
options.text: The gas molecules move more slowly as the temperature increases.

options.label: C
options.text: The pressure of the gas decreases as the temperature increases.

options.label: D
options.text: The pressure of the gas is higher at the top of the jar than at the bottom of the jar.
